reason: This changes instance-wide plan-cache invalidation semantics, centered in `pkg/planner/core/plan_cache_instance.go` with supporting hooks in `pkg/sessionctx/context.go` and `pkg/domain/domain.go`. Global cache eviction on disable is a central planner/session behavior change and can hide high-severity issues around stale plan reuse, incomplete eviction, lifecycle ordering, or concurrency.
